You have MCP tools from the "chromex_browser" server (tool names like mcp__chromex_browser__browser_page_navigate, or browser_page_navigate inside the server).
Use them to drive a browser. Do exactly these steps, in order:
1. browser_page_navigate to http://127.0.0.1:51231/
2. browser_page_snapshot to observe the page
3. browser_page_click the "Go" button
4. browser_page_get (or browser_page_snapshot) to observe the result
If those tools are not callable as functions, the same MCP server is available as a stdio process you can drive yourself:
run `/opt/homebrew/Cellar/node/26.13.0_2/bin/node /Users/tranquangdang21/Projects/chromex/packages/bridge/dist/browser/mcp-stdio.js` with env CHROMEX_MCP_SCOPE_FILE=/var/folders/dd/qv4ltr9158116jk2739rp61c0000gn/T/chromex-accept-gw-T2hJvE/mcp/01M703RS37BNTHM4PRYBX11Z0G.json
It speaks MCP JSON-RPC on stdio (initialize → tools/list → tools/call). Tool names are browser_page_navigate, browser_page_snapshot, browser_page_get, browser_page_click, browser_page_extract, browser_page_screenshot.
Then reply with one line: the h1 text and the #status text you observed.

# These tools ARE the user's browser — the agent owns it. For ANY browser or web-page interaction (open a site, click, type, read page content, inspect network, screenshot, verify results) you MUST call the browser.* tools below. Do NOT use exec_command, shell scripts, browser-use, playwright, curl, or any other browser automation — those bypass the user's real tabs, approvals, and tab scope. Observe before acting (snapshot/get), act with refs, then verify the real outcome before reporting done. If your toolset cannot call these tools directly, run `node /Users/tranquangdang21/Projects/chromex/packages/bridge/dist/browser/mcp-call.js <tool_name> '<json_args>'` via your shell/exec tool instead — first run the same command with --list to see the exact tool names and descriptions.

browser_tabs_list — List tabs this task may see (internal pages and other tasks' tabs excluded; URLs stripped of query/h
browser_tabs_wait — Wait for a NEW tab whose sanitized URL (origin+path) contains urlContains — the async-popup barrier  [args: urlContains,closedTabId,timeoutMs,waitForLoad,disappear]
browser_tab_activate — Bring a tab to the front. tabId optional — defaults to the task's bound tab, then the active tab; ou [args: tabId,tabRef]
browser_tab_close — Close a tab inside this task's scope. Irreversible — prefer leaving tabs open unless the user asked  [args: tabId,tabRef]
browser_tab_create — Open a new tab (http/https only) inside this task's scope; the returned tabId becomes addressable by [args: url,active,windowId,pinned,muted,autoDiscardable]
browser_tab_duplicate — Clone a scoped tab with its session — fork a page to experiment without losing the original's state. [args: tabId,tabRef]
browser_tab_update — Update a scoped tab's chrome state — pinned, muted, autoDiscardable (protect from/prevent Chrome mem [args: tabId,tabRef,pinned,muted,autoDiscardable,frozen,zoomFactor,index,windowId]
browser_page_setInputFiles — Set local file paths on a file input — the path-based equivalent of browser.page.upload for real fil [args: tabId,tabRef,frameId,ref,selector,label,snapshotId,files*,fileChooserId]
browser_page_dialog — Handle the page's open JavaScript dialog (alert/confirm/prompt/beforeunload) — accept or dismiss it  [args: tabId,tabRef,accept,promptText,timeoutMs]
browser_page_snapshot — Capture the page's accessibility/DOM snapshot — it returns an aria snapshot of the page's accessibil [args: tabId,tabRef,frameId,mode(dom|aria)]
browser_page_get — Read tab/page state: chrome-extension returns tab metadata (url/title/active/status/windowId/pinned/ [args: tabId,tabRef,key(text|title|url)]
browser_page_extract — Extract page content as visible text (default) or raw HTML (format:'html'), optionally scoped by CSS [args: tabId,tabRef,frameId,selector,format(text|html),maxChars]
browser_page_screenshot — Capture a screenshot; returns bounded inline JPEG bytes (dataBase64, ≤512KiB decoded — delivered to  [args: tabId,tabRef,frameId,ref,selector,label,snapshotId,fullPage]
browser_page_console — Read the tab's buffered console messages and page errors (level filters by console method e.g. 'erro [args: tabId,tabRef,frameId,level,limit]
browser_page_evaluate — Evaluate a JavaScript expression in the page's MAIN world (real page globals, page credentials, awai [args: tabId,tabRef,frameId,ref,expression,timeoutMs]
browser_page_emulate — Apply browser emulation overrides to the tab: viewport (width/height/deviceScaleFactor/mobile/screen [args: tabId,tabRef,reset,width,height,deviceScaleFactor,mobile,screenWidth,screenHeight,userAgent,timezoneId,geolocation,colorScheme(light|dark|no-preference),reducedMotion(reduce|no-preference),cpuThrottle,network]
browser_page_pdf — Print the tab to PDF via the debugger tier (chrome-extension backend; playwright-isolated via page.p [args: tabId,tabRef,landscape,printBackground,paperWidth,paperHeight]
browser_page_mhtml — Capture the tab as MHTML (multipart/related) via CDP Page.captureSnapshot — the full-fidelity page s [args: tabId,tabRef]
browser_page_click — Click an element — or a viewport coordinate (x,y) for canvas/WebGL/map surfaces that have no DOM tar [args: tabId,tabRef,frameId,ref,selector,label,snapshotId,button(left|right|middle),clickCount(1|2),modifiers,x,y,trusted,expect]
browser_page_focus — Move focus to an element before typing. Same targeting rules as click — ref from a fresh snapshot pr [args: tabId,tabRef,frameId,ref,selector,label,snapshotId,expect]
browser_page_type — Type text into an element keystroke-by-keystroke (appends to existing value). Use browser.page.fill  [args: tabId,tabRef,frameId,ref,selector,label,snapshotId,text,value,trusted,expect]
browser_page_fill — Replace an element's value with text (clears existing content first — unlike type, which appends). O [args: tabId,tabRef,frameId,ref,selector,label,snapshotId,text,value,trusted,expect]
browser_page_select — Choose an option on a <select> element by its value attribute. On playwright-isolated the snapshot i [args: tabId,tabRef,frameId,ref,selector,label,snapshotId,value,values,expect]
browser_page_submit — Submit the form containing the target element. Submitting sends data off-page — confirm intent first [args: tabId,tabRef,frameId,ref,selector,label,snapshotId,expect]
browser_page_scroll — Scroll the page (or the target element) — direction up/down/left/right, plus 'top'/'bottom' on the e [args: tabId,tabRef,frameId,ref,selector,label,snapshotId,direction(up|down|left|right|top|bottom),amountPx,trusted,expect]
browser_page_navigate — Navigate the tab to a URL (required). Navigation invalidates every prior ref and snapshotId — call b [args: tabId,tabRef,frameId,url*,snapshotId,expect]
browser_page_wait — Wait without busy-polling. Bare ms sleeps (0–30000). With a condition — text, textGone, selector, se [args: tabId,tabRef,frameId,ms,timeoutMs,text,textGone,selector,selectorGone,urlContain
